label: prop:chirality-writhe-ribbon-derivation
title: Chirality factor $1 + w \cdot h$ from ribbon-twist framing (writhe $w$)
html:
Proposition. Chirality factor 1 + w \cdot h from ribbon-twist framing (writhe w)

For a braid \beta with integer writhe w(\beta), the chirality factor derived from the Kauffman ribbon-twist evaluation limits strictly to:

  a_K(\beta)
  \;=\;
  1 \;+\; w(\beta) \cdot h \;+\; O(h^2).

The first-order Hecke deformation factor is therefore fixed by the topological writhe.
